purpose: Scene-specific theme realization criteria authored independently before candidate retrieval; these supplement eventual managed hard gates. A full gate needs every named component visible together.

gates.criterion: A physical CRT and VHS playback context contain an obsolete monochrome warehouse recording; at least one unmistakable tape/scan artifact belongs visibly inside the monitor image.
gates.pass_boundary: A vintage color grade alone fails.

gates.criterion: Inside the monitor, an upright wrapped cargo form has an unmistakably human-shaped head-and-shoulder silhouette among ordinary low crates, making the recorded image troubling.
gates.pass_boundary: A normal crate, ordinary standing worker, or hidden silhouette fails.

gates.criterion: The paper shipment record and recorded cargo are visibly linked through the same large 23 identifier, and the paper identifies a crate while the recorded shape is human-like.
gates.pass_boundary: If the identifiers or paper category are partial/unreadable, the full mismatch is unproven.

gates.criterion: The reference-guided woman is visibly investigating the ledger and turning attention toward the CRT with interrupted writing, linking her response to the record.
gates.pass_boundary: An isolated portrait with unrelated retro props fails.

gates.criterion: The fictional subject retains visibly comparable face and short dark bob with wispy bangs from the supplied portrait at a useful review scale.
gates.pass_boundary: This measures appearance guidance only and establishes no real identity.
